signature: SUBROUTINE ZHEEV( JOBZ, UPLO, N, A, LDA, W, WORK, LWORK, RWORK,

params.name: jobz
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
-   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the Hermitian matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading N-by-N upper triangular part of A contains the upper triangular part of the matrix A. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading N-by-N lower triangular part of A contains the lower triangular part of the matrix A. On exit, if `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, A contains the orthonormal eigenvectors of the matrix A. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then on exit the lower triangle (if `UPLO='L'`) or the upper triangle (if `UPLO='U'`) of A, including the diagonal, is destroyed.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: w
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The length of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, N-1)$. For optimal efficiency, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge (\mathrm{NB}+1) \, N$, where NB is the blocksize for ZHETRD returned by ILAENV.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the algorithm failed to converge; i off-diagonal elements of an intermediate tridiagonal form did not converge to zero.
